image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a tangled assortment of jewelry chains and beads on a light-colored surface. The primary subject is a bronze or brass-colored metal chain with oval links, draped in a curve across the right side. To the left, there is a cluster of clear faceted beads and another darker, thinner chain. A green tag with white text is visible in the bottom right corner. The lighting creates specular highlights on the metal links.
